title: ManageEngine ADManager Plus installServiceWithCredentials Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of ManageEngine ADManager Plus. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the installServiceWithCredentials function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
